name: Stalker
# Hunt the nearest enemy cell; when touching it, write the poison glyph @ into it.
# The wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack (like the Roamer).
# Middle row decides: SCAN for an enemy, `|` sends the IP north if found, south if not.
# Found (top row): copy dx,dy (`oo`), write @ there (`'@` pushes the code of @ and
# skips it), then step toward it and adopt that as the wander direction.
# Not found (bottom row): drop dx,dy, keep wandering; turn right when blocked.
# Both rows wrap back to their first cell, which points the IP back into the middle row.
# (Without the branch, a failed SCAN gives 0,0 = my own IP cell, and I poison myself.)
